headline: Stanislaus State end Cal State LA's run of clean sheets
dek: Stanislaus State's goal at Cal State LA was the first scored against them this season, in their eighth match. Cal State LA still won, and they and Cal State San Bernardino, who also won on the day, remain the only unbeaten sides in the conference.
displaced_by: Cal State LA conceded their first goal of the season, to Stanislaus State, and the standing dek said they had still to concede

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's 27 goals are more than Cal State LA and Chico State have scored between them, and ten different players have shared them; the conference's unbeaten sides are not its top scorers.

wire.line: Cal State LA have conceded their first goal of the season, in their eighth match, and won the match anyway.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, every one of them in August; the latest is Chico State's match with Yuba.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won six and drawn two after beating Cal Poly Humboldt at home, and have conceded four goals across those eight matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 29 goals in nine matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn four of their nine matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored eight of Fresno Pacific's 27 goals.

last_match.line: Stanislaus State are the first side to score against Cal State LA this season; Cal State LA are still unbeaten.

next_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino are unbeaten and have won both of their conference matches; Chico State have yet to win one.
